name: The Warrior (Mundus)
note: Weapon and Spell Damage (the game's tooltip); `Power(All)` is what set stat 2 ("both") maps to.

name: The Thief (Mundus)
note: Weapon and Spell Critical Strike rating: `CriticalChance` is the channel both ratings read.

name: The Lady (Mundus)
note: Physical and Spell Resistance: `Armour(All)`, which resistance() adds to the Martial and Spell groups alike.

name: The Steed (Mundus)
note: MovementSpeed is in percentage points (10 = +10 %), like the champion point Celerity.

name: The Apprentice (Mundus)
note: Experience and crafting inspiration gain, 8 % (percentage points). Not spell damage: the game's tooltip says experience. Its twin record 269724 is not modelled. `KillExperience` is the closest channel; it has no crafting-inspiration split.

name: The Ritual (Mundus)
note: HealingDone is in percentage points (8 = +8 %).

name: The Shadow (Mundus)
note: Critical Damage in percentage points (11 = +11 %). The stone also raises critical healing; there is no channel for that yet.
